title: simple explanation
prompt: Explain how a Kubernetes liveness probe differs from a readiness probe in three sentences.

title: code generation
prompt: Write a Go function that walks a directory tree and returns the top 5 largest files. Use filepath.WalkDir. Include error handling for permission denied.

title: reasoning under constraint
prompt: A container with 2 GiB memory is OOMKilled repeatedly. Its RSS is 1.4 GiB. What are three plausible causes and what would you look at first?

title: long-form summarization
prompt: Summarize the three most important ideas in "Attention Is All You Need" (Vaswani et al. 2017) in about 150 words. Output the summary directly; do not include any preamble.

title: structured output
prompt: Produce a JSON object with keys ["incident_summary", "root_cause_hypothesis", "next_action", "blast_radius"]. Each value is a short string. Fabricate a plausible on-call scenario for the content.
